units.title: SG-8.4.1 Single-writer history status in ContributionSheet
Act: Add HistoryStatus state and loading/error messages to ContributionSheet
units.failure:
Act agent reported ok:false: BLOCKED, not completed. While I was editing, another writer changed the same file in this worktree (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx). Its edits add `reloadKey`, a `historyStatus: 'ok' | 'error'` state, and a Retry button, which conflicts with the brief's `HistoryStatus = 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'` design. The index also has 8 staged deletions in that file. The file is now a mix of my edits and theirs: the HistoryStatus type and constants, the `if (cancelled) return;` guard in .catch, and the loading/error

messages are present. The useState for 'loading'|'ready' and the setHistoryStatus('loading'/'ready') calls in the effect are not. Their `'ok' | 'error'` state makes my `historyStatus === 'loading'` render line a type error. I did not overwrite or revert their work, and I made no commit. Next step needs a decision from the owner of the other writer: either pause that session, or confirm whether to keep their Retry design (then this unit's AC needs revising) or replace it with the brief's design. Once the file is stable, I can apply Step 2 and finish Step 3's render.
